a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first almost certainly leaves us both with empty units when the storm hits. I intend to take 4 in round 1 instead of waiting. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can build back up for you. You take whenever it reaches 4.
